root_text: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV), found in 2001, is spreading globally. In late 2024, China saw surging cases, overwhelming hospitals. On Jan 6, 2025, 2 infants in Bengaluru tested positive for HMPV, recovering now. Stay alert, practice hygiene
